examples.english: We ate sandwiches together during the break.

examples.arabic: بعد الظهر، بتغدّى عادة وبقابل أصحابي، بس اليوم بشتغل على إيجاد فرصة تدريب.
examples.english: In the afternoon, I usually have lunch and meet my friends, but today I am working on finding an internship opportunity.
examples.transliteration: Ba'ed ez-zohr, batghadda 'adehtan w baqabel as7abi, bass el-yom bashtaghel 'ala ijad forsat tadreeb.
